hostedAccess: Supabase access and the scoped live view repair are verified: 23 advisor ERROR findings are now zero; 19 local PostgreSQL tests, 70 local integration checks (69 HTTP plus FK cleanup) and read-only live permission assertions passed. Existing records/admin assignments were preserved. Additive onboarding backend is now applied and seven local Auth/email/PKCE scenarios pass; hosted delivery remains pending. Staging is local as Sai requested. Publishing controls and SMTP acceptance, broader APIs/storage and complete community workflows still prevent phase closure. Phase 2 community source workflows and a local-only database candidate are now implemented and tested; no community migration or frontend deployment has been applied live. Public Netlify hosting is now confirmed by live response headers; its deployed branch and publishing controls remain unverified. Phase 3.1–3.8 now meet all eight local commerce criteria, including fictional-provider fulfilment/refunds and bounded capacity. Hosted commerce acceptance remains 0/8. No commerce candidate was applied hosted and no real provider action or paid resource was used.
countingRule: Counts are equally counted checklist criteria, not effort estimates or a claim of production readiness. Local source/fixture verification and hosted acceptance are counted separately. A phase closes only when every criterion and its exit condition is verified.

checks.detail: Declared source/deployment configuration inventoried; environment validation rejects unsafe browser keys.

Netlify serving ayuzee.com is verified from live HTTP headers on 4 November. Deployed branch/commit and Lovable-to-Netlify publishing workflow still need dashboard verification; Supabase project is verified.
Separate local account, directory and role-workspace fixtures use synthetic identities/data.

Free isolated loopback-only Supabase stack is running; synthetic scoped-access schema and 70 integration checks (69 HTTP plus relational cleanup) pass. This is targeted staging, not a complete 429-table replay.
Application/config checks are explicit; scoped checks do not replace the full application job.
Finish full application typecheck diagnosis and obtain its actual diagnostic baseline; prior bounded runs did not complete.
Migration/manual-SQL conflicts are recorded and a catalog inspection query is prepared.
Compare effective schema and migration history; prove reproducible isolated replay.
Functional routes stay behind the preview boundary; designated privileged handlers deny execution in source tests.
Verify actual hosted APIs/functions/policies cannot mutate unready financial or clinical state.
Source build gate stops at failed checks; role policy checks and ledger consistency are included.

DOMPurify patched and pinned to 3.4.17; three sanitizer tests pass. Latest install audit: 56 affected packages (37 moderate, 17 high, two critical); remaining toolchain and Zod upgrades need reviewed follow-up.
Verify Netlify/Lovable publishing controls, actual CI gating and protected release flow. Netlify serving the public domain is now confirmed; dashboard settings and deployed commit remain unavailable.
Verify actual error delivery, privacy configuration and operational ownership.
Original account/role candidates have isolated PostgreSQL tests. The role boundary is now included in the applied scoped repair; onboarding/public-profile candidates remain separate.
Reconcile actual schema/RPCs and verify direct account/profile/doctor API denial in staging.
Applied scoped repair to 21 views, 17 supporting-table policy fences, six authority guards and role writes; live advisor ERRORs 23→0 and read-only acceptance passed. Other APIs/storage remain open.

Applied additive onboarding RPC/table and patient-only Auth bootstrap; read-only live ACL/unknown-identity assertions pass. Existing 36 role rows and 15 profiles remain; no existing account auto-completed.
Signup, email return and resumable onboarding are tested locally; requested role never grants access.

Live dashboard verified custom SMTP and email confirmation are disabled. Site URL/redirect origin match ayuzee.com. Existing company SMTP sender plus coordinated real confirmation/recovery delivery are required; local Mailpit passes do not close this check.

Seven real local Auth/Mailpit/PKCE/API scenarios pass: signup confirmation, persisted onboarding, own data/role denial, refresh/logout, password recovery and used-link rejection. Hosted SMTP/delivery remains unverified.
Single account observer rejects stale identity/role results and clears private query state.
Verify real login, refresh, logout and role removal with actual Auth/database policies.
Expired/invalid links, recovery transport, identity changes and sign-out failure paths have local tests.
Prove real delivered recovery email through reset and successful re-entry.
All 17 source account/admin roles have explicit portal/read mappings; unknown roles fail closed.
Role-specific navigation/cards, account destinations and explicit multi-role switching are implemented and tested.
New workspace direct routes reject cross-role/unknown access before protected children mount and clear scoped queries on context changes.
All 12 source hospital role contracts require actor/org/branch/module/status/expiry; clinical contracts also require assignment. No membership API is connected.
Inventory and connect all legacy menus/routes/search/notifications/action entrypoints to reviewed capability policies; current preview containment remains.
Implement authoritative scoped membership adapters and reviewed write/approve/export/sign/dispense/settle contracts. Current portals display read previews only.

Reconcile deployed roles, custom templates, assignments, professional approval/suspension and membership scope. MCP project/schema access is now verified; the policy/membership audit remains to be completed.
Prove backend/database/storage isolation and freshness/revocation independently of UI for every released role/scope/operation.

Shared app navigation and opt-in app footer use the role/workspace policy across all 17 roles. Multiple grants require workspace selection; account/error/loading states hide private tools; public previews still make no account calls.
Account/portal render tests cover readable states, focus and keyboard controls; desktop/mobile workspace browser review recorded in local handover.
Read-only dashboard: new signups allowed, anonymous sign-ins off, email confirmation off. Verify enforced throttling and complete production Auth journeys after SMTP is arranged.
Finish profile editing, credential-review UI and explicit public-field projection.
Verify professional approval/suspension, public opt-in and private-field isolation end to end.
Bounded URL-driven directory search/filter/sort/pagination, runtime projection validation and accessible state tests are implemented; candidate view is absent live and the route remains a preview.
Create and verify the approved-only, opt-in public directory contract and real search/pagination/empty/error journeys.

Modular post composer and owned edit/delete flows, workspace-specific audiences, bounded URL search/type/sort/pagination, validation and failed-draft retention are locally tested. The shared candidate API is PostgreSQL-tested; hosted migration and route release remain pending.
Prove ownership, doctor-only and public audience rules through direct APIs.
Comment creation/own deletion and idempotent likes refresh persisted state; UI failure handling and PostgreSQL ownership, parent-audience fences, counters and transaction rollback pass locally.
Prove duplicate-action prevention and unauthorized comment/like mutation denial.

Poll votes persist one choice per account with expiry/choice validation. Reports deduplicate and authorized hide/dismiss decisions require a reason and persist an immutable moderation record in the local PostgreSQL candidate.
Verify one vote per account, report ownership and moderator permissions.

Removed fabricated global alerts. Community notifications use recipient-scoped records, durable read/dismiss actions and UUID-derived internal links; local tests prove immutable payloads, trusted delivery ACLs and transaction rollback. No hosted delivery is claimed.
Verify recipient isolation, delivery persistence and authenticated provider boundaries without paid integrations.

Responsive feed/editor and desktop/mobile role views reviewed; the 390px patient feed passes 26 axe checks with zero violations/incomplete checks and no horizontal overflow. Complete remaining metadata/crawler and loading measurements before closing this criterion.
Verify the actual released community pages and metadata after an explicitly authorized deployment.
Define a representative synthetic 1,000-user community workload and pass free local acceptance; do not infer live capacity from it.
Agree and verify the deployed capacity claim within existing free limits and explicit load-test authorization.

Approved-only public projection, URL search/category/system/stock filters, sort/pagination and detail states; canonical manufacturer submissions and reviewer approval/rejection/withdrawal, owned editing and feedback are locally tested.
Reconcile all deployed grants and alternate RPC consumers, run native local REST/Auth tests, then separately deploy and verify catalog ownership/publication with real roles.

Server-only integer-paise pricing, strict ID/quantity cart, configurable tax-inclusive delivery/coupon rules and expiring quotes; responsive UI validates totals, invalidates changed input and fails closed when rules/storage are missing. Local PostgreSQL/native/browser verification passes; production business rules remain unapproved.
Verify real pricing rules and tampered browser requests against the released API; no paid resources or real charge is authorized.

Owned pending unpaid orders, persisted request-key recovery/history, exact retries, atomic stock/coupon holds, logical expiry, trusted cleanup and unpaid release pass local tests. Real concurrent REST requests for the last item yield exactly one reservation; coupon expiry and role revocation during lock waits are denied.
Verify native/hosted transaction retries and competing requests for the last item; read/write fences alone do not implement checkout.

Test-only payment attempt binds real customer/order, stored provider order ID, receipt, INR amount and verified capture; exact retries, cross-purchase replay denial and atomic stock commit pass isolated and native local tests. No live provider call or hosted release is claimed.
Verify the existing provider test-mode integration and trusted boundary without making real charges.

Signed raw-body event inbox, duplicate/body-conflict handling, leased retries/dead letters, closed-browser reconciliation and lost-create recovery without duplicate POST are locally verified. Minimal payment identity survives Auth deletion; late/additional captures enter review without false fulfilment. Owned read-only status UI passes local checks.
Verify delayed/repeated provider test events, failed payments and reconciliation; do not invoke paid provider operations.

Private persisted packing/booking/tracking, explicit order operations roles, one claim, uncertain-create recovery, event deduplication and owned delivery UI pass 74 source cases and 10 native local scenarios. Legacy courier source entrypoints fail closed; no live provider call or deployment.
Verify authorized courier test-mode outcomes, failure and retry, within existing no-cost access.

Owned pre-booking cancellation, stock restoration once, bound integer-paise partial/full refunds, durable retry keys and original-reference recovery pass 81 source cases and nine native Auth/REST scenarios, including actual concurrent balance/permission races. No real refund or provider request.
Verify provider test-mode refund reconciliation; no real refund or financial transaction is authorized.

Bounded native local workload passes five scenarios: 550 catalog products, 240 anonymous filtered requests at concurrency 8, 24 independent reservations, 20 final-item contenders, 16 same-key retries and 40 ownership denials. Measured latency is workstation-only, not a production SLA.
Agree and verify the deployed capacity claim within existing free limits and explicit load-test authorization.

executionStatus: Phase 3 authorized local scope is complete: 8/8 local, 0/8 hosted; exit not accepted. Full unit/contract suite 461 tests, 40 standalone SQL cases, seven-handler containment, nine new native refund and five bounded capacity scenarios pass. No provider API request, real charge/refund/courier operation, paid resource, hosted commerce migration, publishing, commit or push occurred. Source cleanup is archived and commit preparation targets Sai-Branch only. Earlier phase debt/hosted gates and optional feature decisions remain open.
